newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia killers preyed on poor in insurance scam.
newsitem.headline: Colombia killers preyed on poor in insurance scam.

text.p: Police said on Friday that they had arrested the leader of a gang of killers who posed as good samaritans and preyed on poor or destitute Colombians as part of a deadly life insurance scam.
The gang was headed by Reinaldo Riascos Hurtado, who was nabbed by police in the Pacific port city of Buenaventura, a police statement said.

It said Riascos and his underlings provided economic assistance to beggars, prostitutes and other street people in Buenaventura, ultimately helping them to open banks accounts and take out life insurance policies.
But soon after the policy-holders would turn up dead, the victims of apparent freak accidents, the statement said.
It said two would-be victims of the gang tipped off police after narrow brushes with death and that the authorities had launched a nationwide manhunt for Riascos' accomplices.
At least three people were murdered by the gang, which successfully cashed in on their life insurance policies, the police statement said.
